text:
maria: seeing a short but nasty queue spike on prod-east-2 around 09:42, warm-pool didn't prewarm enough, backlog growth ~18k reqs/s -> 45k token backlog in 30s. logs show many soft-admits and hedged probes.
kevin: ugh. did admission drop tokens or was it provisioning lag? any network hiccups reported?
oliver: looks like capacity was fine in us-east-1 but east-2 faced a regional VM scheduling delay. k8s events show transient pod Pending due to node quota. not infra-wide.
maria: stack: inference service -> admission layer -> warm-pool -> GPU pods. admission started shedding at 09:42:12 after latency climbed above 250ms. warm-pool scale-up started but prewarm window too narrow so cold starts hit.
liz: can you paste the admission metrics query? want to check token burn vs queue size.
maria: grafana query: `sum(rate(admission_granted[1m])) by (pool)` and `sum(rate(admission_rejected[1m])) by (reason)`; backlog metric: `inference_queue_length`
kevin: suggestion: implement signal-dampening on the queue growth to avoid oscillatory scaling. current heuristic reacts to instantaneous slope; proposal: use a sigmoidal ramp + probe window (30s) before hard-shedding.
oliver: i like the probe window. also add a lightweight liveliness probe that precreates warm contexts (cheap) so kernel JITs are amortized without full pod spinup.
maria: rough config patch I'm thinking: ```yaml
warm_pool:
  min_active: 8
  prewarm_threshold: 0.45 # fraction of capacity
  probe_window_sec: 30
  sigmoid_alpha: 0.6
  soft_admit_ratio: 0.15
```
liz: cost callout: increasing min_active and probe freq increases GPU-hours. can we trade with more aggressive KV-prefix caching to cut token compute?
kevin: yes, caching wins for repeated prefixes. but for bursty cold-starts caching helps only if prefix reuse exists. we should make the prewarm adaptive by workload.
infra-bot: [09:43:01] autoscaler: scale-up start pool=warm-east-2 delta=6 target=14 reason=queue_growth
infra-bot: [09:43:25] autoscaler: scale-up succeeded pool=warm-east-2 ready=12
maria: action plan: 1) add probe_window=30s + sigmoid damping in admission logic (canary) 2) enable cheap prewarm probe (kernel/JIT warm) 3) temporarily raise min_active to 12 for east-2 overnight 4) monitor token_rejection and p95 latency.
oliver: ok to canary 10% traffic for this change? we should also add a fallback policy to lower soft_admit_ratio if cost > threshold.
kevin: I'll PR admission changes, include feature flag `damped_prewarm_v1`, add metric `admission_damping_factor`.
liz: finance: if cost delta > 8% projected, auto-revert. I'll add dashboard alert.
maria: timeline: PR today, infra-canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC, rollback window 2h. anyone opposed?
oliver: +1
kevin: +1, will include a short kill-switch in config for ops.
infra-bot: [09:44:38] deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated: damped_prewarm_v1=on pct=10
maria: thanks all — will keep an eye on queue metrics and post updates here. :eyes:
